The '''''PaleShadow''''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''PaleShadow'' appeared in early drafts for ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', as a companion vessel for the ''[[FarStar]]''. The vessel never made it through the editing process, and was cut from the final product.
